full_chain: Registries.preInit registers the actual boss, turret and projectile; proxy.preInit binds actual boss renderer; SoundRegistry class is registered on Forge event bus.

Each boss initializes all twenty face bits active and a separate 1x1 inner core AABB. EntityDamageSource selects immediate entity before true source, forms a 64-scaled look/motion ray, rotates it into shield coordinates, tests active faces and selects by face-centroid distance. A face refusal returns false from boss damage. A hole only permits calling super.attackEntityFrom if the same ray also intersects the inner core; parent result is preserved.

For refused entity damage, a boss-local Entity-object map independently budgets true source and immediate source. An absent entry receives velocity overwrite, a MAGIC 2 attempt and map value 10 regardless of damage result. Same source object is admitted once because first insertion suppresses second. NOPE sound is emitted when at least one map entry was newly admitted; it is not a successful-damage receipt. Countdown removes an entry on a later update after it reaches zero.

Normal boss turret production chooses deflectable state. Turret update creates a projectile with boss owner and transfers the deflectable flag. Sword-player damage on a deflectable projectile attempts startRiding if player has no passengers, broadcasts passengers and returns true without checking mounting success. While riding, a non-swing observation arms release; later swing shoots, dismounts and changes only thrower to player. Original owner remains boss. Collision excludes thrower, allowing the returned projectile to reach boss.

Projectile boss impact raycasts active faces; server clears one face bit and emits SHIELD_DOWN, spawns eighteen supporting projectiles, and sets boss floating=false. If no face is hit it calls GENERIC 10, which this boss rejects because it is neither EntityDamageSource nor out-of-world; return is ignored and server still drops floating state. No claim of ten actual HP damage.

Boss server publishes packed face bits during alive update only when player list in grown 32x16x32 AABB is nonempty; client reads packed state each update. Actual registered renderer skips inactive faces and consumes local per-face animation ticks. attackShield client branch can set animation=20, but no dedicated server-to-client hit-receipt packet is shown, so authoritative hit flash delivery is NOT claimed. Random client ambience uses 40->21 then resets at20, distinct from local hit animation.

NBT saves packed faces and deathTicks; reading only accepts INT shields, preserving constructor state if absent. Recoil map and per-face animation are transient. Death update clears faces by deathTicks and publishes packed data; XP/loot are not counted as another researched mechanism. Blockade boss-owned branch can heal health after player damage; shield repair belongs to its separate player-capability branch and is not attributed to this boss.
static_boundaries: Geometry is not proven correct: rayTraceTriangle only tests 1-t>epsilon, not t>=0; candidate chooses closest face centroid, not intersection parameter. RotationMatrix returns early for initial zero angles with its default zero matrix. These are static observations, not executed repros.
Projectile shield trace supplies getShieldRotationYaw for roll, unlike ordinary boss attack and renderer using roll. Do not claim precise hit/render agreement.

Creative non-sneaking entity bypasses shield but still needs core; sneaking branch may cast a non-player attacker to EntityPlayer without a preceding type test. No claim that native mobs naturally trigger that edge.

Recoil normalization has no zero-length guard; true/immediate damage calls ignore their result. Map is per boss/live Entity object, not UUID/epoch/cast ID. Reload loses budget. Source-less attacks are rejected except matching outOfWorld damage type; there is no generic rejection cue for every false result.

Projectile owner resolution searches local entities within64; missing/unloaded owner is not same as confirmed dead owner. Lifetime ticks increment only while not riding; setDead at >200 does not immediately return. Mount attempt result and world.spawnEntity results are ignored.

Death cleanup list is queried as EntityWight.class before later instanceof tests for turrets/projectiles/blockades; those later types are not established members of that queried list. Do not claim complete owned-add cleanup or crash-atomic XP settlement.

MC/Forge1.12 platform internals, actual packet timing, super damage admission, audible output and rendered pixels have not been executed or independently reconstructed. The proposed unit is the complete mod-owned predicate/state/call/consumer chain, not validated cross-version behavior.
application: Keep rejection, opening a defense and health admission as distinct outcomes; scope feedback to the actual defense owner and transition. Preserve face-state/core-stage semantics when comparing references, but do not port legacy geometry, resources, platform APIs or gameplay into production. UI verification is unrelated to package coordination acceptance.
unexecuted_acceptance_obligations: Active face versus inactive hole versus core miss; parent refusal must remain refusal.
True source equals immediate source versus distinct source objects; budget expiry and reload behavior.
Returned projectile changes thrower only; face removal versus generic damage refusal; missing owner versus dead owner.
Server face bits versus client local hit animation; missing player publication window and death teardown.
Negative ray t, zero rotation/zero recoil distance and yaw-for-roll mismatch require native reproduction before claiming runtime defects.
counting: One pending owner family at most; references, lines, branches, shield faces, acceptance obligations and support files earn zero individually.
